## Activation Contract

Use when touching `src/shared/ui/pdf/` or `src/modules/cv/presentation/components/cv-pdf-*.tsx`, or when the exported/previewed PDF is cut, blank, missing a font, or paginates wrong.

## Hard Rules

- Never import `@react-pdf/renderer` outside `src/shared/ui/pdf/` — module code imports `Document`/`Page`/`View`/`Text`/`StyleSheet`/`PdfViewer`/`PDFDownloadButton` from `@shared/ui/pdf` only.
- `<Page>` paginates automatically — never hand-roll page-break math (no `computeBreaks`, no `zoom`/`transform` scaling hacks). One `<Page>` element can render many physical pages.
- Any block that must not be split across a page break (a job entry, a side-list entry, a skill row) gets `wrap={false}` on its outer `View` — this is the only mechanism for "keep together", there is no CSS `break-inside` equivalent.
- Two-tone column backgrounds (sidebar color + white main column) are `position: 'absolute'` `View`s with the `fixed` prop so they repeat, full-bleed, on every physical page — never rely on a flex sibling's stretched height for a background that must survive pagination.
- Units default to points (`pt`); physical sizes (`cm`, `mm`) work as string values (`'1cm'`) and are converted internally — do not reintroduce px-based A4 pixel math.
- Fonts are self-hosted from `public/fonts/`, registered generically from `pdf-fonts.config.mjs` — never point `Font.register` at an external CDN (jsDelivr/Fontsource-hosted URLs have failed with `DataView` parsing errors in this project) and never use `next/font/google` (it has no raw file react-pdf's fontkit can load).
- Bullet lists and skill bars have no native element — compose them from `View`/`Text` rows (`•` + text row; a background `View` track + a width-percent fill `View`).
- Document-level vertical margins (top/bottom) belong on `<Page style>`, never on a column `View` — react-pdf re-applies a `Page`'s own padding on EVERY generated physical page, but a child `View`'s padding applies only once across its whole (paginated) box. Horizontal margins are fine on a column `View` since horizontal layout doesn't change across page breaks. A `fixed` absolute `View` positioned `top/bottom: 0` is inset by the `Page`'s own padding box — if `Page` has vertical padding, compensate with `top: '-{margin}cm'` / `bottom: '-{margin}cm'` to keep a full-bleed background reaching the true page edge.
- `<Link>` defaults to blue + underline (`DEFAULT_LINK_STYLES`) — always pass an explicit `style` with `color` and `textDecoration: 'none'` (or whatever the design calls for); the default is applied before your `style` prop, so it's fully overridable but never implicitly matches body text.
- No brand icon packages are installable here: `@fortawesome/*` is scope-mapped in `.npmrc` to a private registry that 401s, and `simple-icons` dropped LinkedIn's mark after a trademark takedown. Solid icon paths are inlined by hand in `pdf-icon.tsx` (sourced from Heroicons/lucide-react, both permissively licensed) as `Path`/`Rect`/`Circle` shape data — add new icons the same way, never install a DOM-only icon package for PDF use (react-pdf can't render `<svg>`/`<path>` DOM elements from a React component, only its own `Svg`/`Path`/`Rect`/`Circle` primitives).
- `pdf-fonts.config.mjs` has 15 bundled families (all OFL via `@fontsource/*`, all with a verified `features` array). Never add Arial/Tahoma/Calibri/Times New Roman/Georgia as literal proprietary fonts — they can't be legally self-hosted from this repo. Use their metric-compatible OFL substitutes instead: Arial→`arimo`, Times New Roman→`tinos`, Calibri→`carlito`, Georgia→`gelasio`; label the config entry's `family` with the recognizable name (e.g. `family: 'Arial'`, `fontsourceId: 'arimo'`) and say so in a comment. Tahoma has no dedicated Google metric clone — its entry reuses the already-registered `noto-sans` files under its own `family: 'Tahoma'` label (`Font.register` allows two family names pointing at the same font files; no new package or copy step needed).
- `fontFeatureSettings` (OpenType tags like `smcp`/`onum`/`ss01`) only has a visible effect if the REGISTERED FONT FILE actually implements that GSUB/GPOS rule — it's a font capability, not a react-pdf setting. Every `PdfFontConfig` entry in `pdf-fonts.config.mjs` carries its own `features: string[]` (verified with `fontkit`, same lib react-pdf/font uses internally, never guessed): `node -e "const fontkit = require('<path-to>/node_modules/.pnpm/fontkit@<version>/node_modules/fontkit'); console.log(fontkit.openSync('public/fonts/<id>/<file>.woff').availableFeatures)"`. `TypographyDialog`'s OpenType tab filters its full tag catalog down to each font's own `features` list at runtime — so a new font (bundled or user-uploaded, Fase 4) with richer support shows more toggles automatically, with zero dialog code changes, as long as its `features` array is accurate. Never hardcode a fixed tag list in the dialog again. Noto Sans (the bundled default) only implements `ccmp, dnom, frac, liga, numr, pnum, tnum, kern, mark, mkmk` — `dlig`/`hlig`/`calt`/`onum`/`lnum`/`zero`/`smcp`/`c2sc`/`ss01`-`ss20` are no-ops with it today.
- **Custom fonts (Fase 4)**: an uploaded font is registered dynamically at runtime via `registerCustomFont(id, family, mimeType, base64Content, fontWeight)` (`shared/ui/pdf/custom-fonts.ts`) under a family literally named `` `custom-${regularId}` `` — never the user-facing display name, and ALWAYS with an explicit `fontStyle: 'normal'` + `fontWeight` (400 or 700). Both are mandatory: `@react-pdf/font`'s `FontFamily.resolve()` filters registered faces by EXACT `fontStyle`/`fontWeight` match and never falls back from `undefined`, so a face registered without them is simply never found (`Could not resolve font for X`) — verified by reading `@react-pdf/font`'s own source, not assumed. A regular + optional bold pair share the SAME family string (keyed off the regular file's id) with `fontWeight` 400/700 respectively; `Font.register` called twice for the same family ACCUMULATES faces (verified in source — `FontFamily.register` pushes into a `sources` array, it never replaces), so this is safe. Registration itself is guarded by a module-level `Set` keyed by each file's own Drive id, so calling it twice for the same id is a no-op. `resolveTypography` (`template-config.ts`) already computes this exact same `` `custom-${customFontId}` `` string when `typography.customFontId` is set — the two sides are never wired manually, they just agree on the naming convention. **Never render `CvPdfDocument` before every requested face's `Font.register` call has actually run** (gate on `useCustomFont(id, boldId).isReady`, not merely on the fetches resolving) — react-pdf reads the `FontStore` at its own internal render pass, and an unregistered family silently falls back to Helvetica (or throws a caught, console-only error) with no visible UI error, which looks like a font-capability bug rather than a timing issue. **`isReady` must compare the currently-registered id against the current target id, never a one-way boolean** — a plain `useState(false)` that only ever flips to `true` stays stuck `true` forever once a font is swapped for a different one, since it never resets when the id prop changes; track `registeredRegularId`/`registeredBoldId` state instead and compare with `===`.
- A font uploaded to Drive is stored as its **base64 TEXT**, not decoded binary — `POST /api/fonts` sends the browser's `FileReader.readAsDataURL` base64 straight to `DriveRepository.createFile(..., base64Content, mimeType)`, and `getFile()` (`alt=media`, `responseType:'text'`) reads that same base64 text back unchanged. This lets `Font.register({ src: 'data:<mimeType>;base64,<content>' })` consume it directly with zero re-encoding, at the cost of Drive storing ~33% more bytes than the raw binary — an accepted tradeoff for reusing the existing string-only `createFile`/`getFile` API instead of adding a binary code path.
- Server-side upload validation (`modules/font/infrastructure/font-validation.ts`) never trusts the client's declared MIME type — it sniffs real magic bytes (`OTTO`/`wOFF`/`wOF2`/sfnt-v1 `0x00010000`/`true`), caps size at `MAX_FONT_SIZE_BYTES` (2 MB), and explicitly rejects font collections (`.ttc`/`.otc`, detected as a fontkit `FontCollection` with a `fonts` array) since `Font.register` throws on those.
- **`fontkit`'s ESM build has no default export** (`dist/module.mjs` only has named exports: `create`, `open`, `openSync`, `defaultLanguage`, `setDefaultLanguage`, `registerFormat`, `logErrors`). `import fontkit from 'fontkit'` compiles fine with `tsc` and even "works" if you sanity-check it with `node -e "require('fontkit')"` in a terminal (CJS `require()` synthesizes a default from `module.exports`, masking the difference) — but it throws `Export default doesn't exist in target module` at runtime inside a Next.js/Turbopack route. Always `import { create } from 'fontkit'` (named import).

## Decision Gates

| Symptom                                                                   | Cause                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Fix                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Export button shows blank page / app header                               | Using `window.print()` / a print-only DOM portal                                                                                                                                                               | Use `PDFDownloadButton` with a `pdfDocument` prop — no `window.print()` anywhere                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| An entry is visually cut at a page boundary                               | Its outer `View` is missing `wrap={false}`                                                                                                                                                                     | Add `wrap={false}` to that entry's wrapper                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Sidebar/main background doesn't extend on page 2+                         | Background `View` isn't `fixed` and/or isn't `position: 'absolute'`                                                                                                                                            | Mark both background `View`s `fixed`, positioned against the `Page`, before the flowing content in JSX order                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `RangeError: Offset is outside the bounds of the DataView` on load        | A registered font `src` returned non-font bytes (bad CDN response)                                                                                                                                             | Point `Font.register` at a self-hosted `/fonts/...` path from `pdf-fonts.config.mjs`, never an external CDN                                                                                                                                                                               |
| New font weight/family needed                                             | —                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `pnpm add -D @fontsource/<name>`, add an entry to `pdf-fonts.config.mjs`, run `pnpm pdf-fonts:copy`                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Unicode glyph (e.g. a dingbat/symbol icon) doesn't render in the PDF      | Registered font has no glyph for that codepoint — no browser fallback in react-pdf                                                                                                                             | Use a plain text label instead of the symbol                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Content respects margins on page 1 but bleeds to the edge on page 2+      | Vertical margin is a column `View`'s padding, not `<Page>`'s — it only applies once, not per physical page                                                                                                     | Move `paddingTop`/`paddingBottom` to `<Page style>`; compensate any `fixed` full-bleed background's `top`/`bottom` by the same amount                                                                                                                                                     |
| A link renders blue and underlined despite a custom `style`               | `style` didn't set `color`/`textDecoration` — `DEFAULT_LINK_STYLES` still wins on those properties                                                                                                             | Add explicit `color` and `textDecoration: 'none'` to the `Link`'s `style`                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Uploaded font's text renders in the fallback font (Helvetica-ish)         | `CvPdfDocument` rendered before `Font.register` for `` `custom-${id}` `` actually ran                                                                                                                          | Gate the render on `useCustomFont(id).isReady`, not on the fetch alone — see `editor-client.tsx`                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `Could not resolve font for custom-X, fontWeight 400/700`                 | A face was registered without explicit `fontStyle`/`fontWeight` — `FontFamily.resolve()` filters by exact match and never falls back from `undefined`                                                          | Always pass `fontStyle: 'normal'` and a concrete `fontWeight` (400/700) to every `Font.register` call, bundled or custom                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `Font family not registered: custom-X` right after swapping fonts         | `isReady`/ready-state used a one-way boolean that never reset when the id changed to a NEW font                                                                                                                | Track readiness by comparing the currently-registered id to the target id (`registeredId === id`), never a plain latch-once boolean                                                                                                                                                       |
| Preview stuck forever on "Loading your custom font…"                      | `customFontId`/`customFontBoldId` points at a font deleted or never uploaded (stale/duplicate id) — its `GET /api/fonts/[id]` 404s and `isReady` never had an escape hatch for a query that will NEVER resolve | `useCustomFont`'s `isReady` must also flip true on that face's own `isError` (not just on successful registration), so a permanently-failing fetch unblocks rendering (falls back to Helvetica) instead of blocking it forever; surface `isError` as a toast so the fallback isn't silent |
| `Export default doesn't exist in target module` for a new server-side lib | The lib's ESM build has no default export; a CJS `require()` sanity check in a terminal masks this                                                                                                             | Grep the lib's `dist/*.mjs` for `^export` and use the exact named exports it declares, never assume a default import works                                                                                                                                                                |
| `POST /api/fonts` returns 400 for a real font file                        | Magic-byte sniff failed (wrong container) or it's a `.ttc`/`.otc` collection                                                                                                                                   | Re-export as plain TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2, or convert the collection to a single-font file first                                                                                                                                                                                              |

## Execution Steps

1. Compose new CV sections in `cv-pdf-main.tsx` / `cv-pdf-sidebar.tsx` using `View`/`Text` from `@shared/ui/pdf`; wrap each repeatable entry with `wrap={false}`.
2. For a new font, edit `pdf-fonts.config.mjs` only — `fonts.ts` and `copy-pdf-fonts.mjs` are generic and need no changes.
3. Run `pnpm pdf-fonts:copy` after any font config change, then `pnpm type-check`.
4. Verify both surfaces: `PdfViewer` (live preview panel) and `PDFDownloadButton` (exported file) — they render the same `CvPdfDocument`, so a fix in one always fixes both.

## Output Contract

The live preview (`PdfViewer`) and the exported file (`PDFDownloadButton`) are pixel-identical, paginate natively via `<Page>`, never cut a `wrap={false}` block mid-entry, and load every font from `public/fonts/` with no external network dependency at render time.
